protocol.hypothesis: Published carry/positioning mechanism motivates an original directional perpetual-funding fade, NOT cash-and-carry replication. Oppose completed funding rate of >=1 or >=3 bps per 8h; confirmed version requires preceding 24h return in proposed direction. Rate normalized using elapsed interval; first event skipped. Signal waits 15 min after settlement, uses last closed hourly candle, entry one further minute later. Stop 2 hourly ATR; no target, 24h timeout; one signal per funding event.
protocol.selection_rule: Require positive development AND selection, >=30 selection trades, selection PF>=1.15 and DD<8%; highest selection PF wins (listed order breaks ties). If none, reject all WITHOUT opening holdout.
protocol.admission: Locked candidate: both holdouts positive PF>=1.15 DD<8%, combined >=100 trades; both holdouts positive at 9bps adverse execution per side and for each threshold +/-10%; no retuning. Paper observation still required.
protocol.independence: 2024 Jan-Nov absent from prior recorded experiments; warmup 2024 December from round2 excluded. Conditional on complete repository record; paper development may overlap historical holdout, so prospective verification remains necessary.
limitations: Funding is not futures basis; directional adaptation may have no edge.
Survivor universe BTC ETH SOL; no full exchange universe.
Fixed spread/slippage proxy, no historical bid/ask.
Minute OHLC stop-first, funding mark-minute-open approximation.
Repeated family searches; no claim of statistical significance from positive PnL alone.
